out.title: 244 Haze Drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
Manjot Bawa & Amit Chahal proudly present 244 Haze Drive, Point Cook — a beautifully crafted Porter Davis residence where thoughtful family design, inviting interiors and effortless indoor-outdoor living come together to create a home filled with warmth, comfort and character.

From the moment you arrive, there is something instantly welcoming about this property. The beautifully presented façade, manicured front garden and timeless architectural styling create an elegant first impression, while the warmly illuminated entrance hints at the inviting spaces waiting beyond.

Designed for families who appreciate space without compromising connection, this impressive single-level residence delivers four bedrooms, two bathrooms, multiple living zones, a dedicated rumpus, expansive open-plan family and dining areas, alfresco entertaining and a double garage — all wrapped within a highly functional Porter Davis floor plan.

Step through the front door and a long, inviting hallway begins the journey through the home. Warm timber-look flooring, fresh neutral tones and an abundance of natural light give the interiors a calming, contemporary feel. Every space flows effortlessly into the next, creating a home that feels both generous and wonderfully connected.

Positioned privately toward the front of the residence, the master bedroom provides a relaxing retreat away from the main family hub. Large windows welcome beautiful natural light, while soft neutral finishes create a peaceful atmosphere to begin and end each day. The suite is complemented by a walk-in robe and private ensuite, providing the comfort and privacy expected from a well-designed family home.

The remaining three bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged through the central section of the residence, making the layout ideal for growing families, children or visiting guests. These rooms are serviced by the stylish main bathroom, where a freestanding bathtub creates a beautiful focal point alongside a separate shower, modern vanity and calming neutral finishes.

It is a space designed not only for everyday practicality but also for those quiet moments when you simply want to unwind.

Bright, fresh and incredibly inviting, it combines crisp white cabinetry, generous preparation surfaces, excellent storage, stainless-steel appliances and a large central island that naturally becomes the meeting point of the home. Whether preparing dinner for the family, enjoying breakfast before school or entertaining friends on the weekend, the kitchen is designed to make everyday living feel effortless.

A pantry and adjoining storage areas further enhance its practicality, while its connection to the dining and family zones ensures whoever is cooking remains part of the conversation.

The adjoining dining space offers plenty of room for memorable family dinners, celebrations and long evenings with friends. Warm timber tones, beautiful natural light and the home's neutral palette create an atmosphere that feels sophisticated without ever losing its sense of comfort.

The spacious family area at the rear forms the perfect everyday gathering place, framed by expansive windows that bring the garden into the interior. Beautifully styled and wonderfully bright, this is a room where you can genuinely imagine the family coming together — movie nights on the sofa, children playing nearby or quiet evenings overlooking the garden.

For families wanting extra separation, the dedicated rumpus offers another valuable living zone. It could become the children's retreat, games room, television room, second lounge or simply a private place to unwind away from the main living area.

That flexibility is what makes the Porter Davis design work so beautifully for real family life.

As the day turns to evening, the home becomes even more special.

Large openings create a seamless transition from the interior to the covered alfresco, transforming the rear of the property into a wonderful entertaining environment. The timber deck, warm lighting and comfortable outdoor setting create an intimate atmosphere for summer barbecues, weekend gatherings or simply enjoying a coffee while overlooking the backyard.

Beyond the alfresco, the beautifully maintained garden provides a wonderful sense of privacy and tranquillity. Established flowering garden beds frame the home with colour, while the generous lawn gives children and pets genuine room to enjoy the outdoors.

It is easy to imagine birthday celebrations spilling onto the lawn, friends gathering under the alfresco and relaxed summer evenings stretching long after sunset.

The relationship between the family room, kitchen, alfresco and backyard is particularly impressive, creating that sought-after indoor-outdoor lifestyle that so many families want but few homes deliver this naturally.

Additional features further enhance everyday comfort, including a separate laundry, excellent storage throughout, heating and cooling, quality flooring, beautifully maintained gardens and secure double-garage accommodation with convenient internal access.

Yet what truly separates 244 Haze Drive is not simply its list of features.

It is the way the home feels.

There is warmth in the timber floors, softness in the neutral interiors and a beautiful sense of connection between each living space. It is spacious without feeling overwhelming, stylish without feeling clinical and practical without sacrificing personality.

This is the type of home where every stage of family life can unfold.

Morning coffees in the kitchen. Children doing homework around the dining table. Sunday afternoons in the backyard. Friends gathering beneath the alfresco. Quiet evenings together in the family room.

Every part of the residence has been created to make those everyday moments more enjoyable.

Set within the highly sought-after Point Cook community, the location places families within easy reach of local schools, childcare facilities, parks, walking trails, shopping, cafés, public transport and major road connections, ensuring the lifestyle outside the home is every bit as convenient as the lifestyle within it.

Beautifully presented, thoughtfully designed and filled with natural warmth, 244 Haze Drive, Point Cook represents an outstanding opportunity for buyers searching for a quality Porter Davis home with genuine family flexibility and an exceptional indoor-outdoor lifestyle.

This isn't simply a house with four bedrooms and multiple living areas.

It is a home designed for memories, connection and the next chapter of family life.

Please Call Manjot Bawa 0433 853 301 for more information.

Situated at about 21 kms from Melbourne CBD, this is a prestigious location close to parklands, wetlands and walking distance to the shops. It also offers proximity to quality childcare facilities and is situated within the prestigious schools. It is close to medical facilities shares easy public transport access and is situated right near the freeway, saving time.
Photo ID required for all inspections.

Welcome to 25 Newhaven Drive, Williams Landing. Offering a remarkable fusion of luxury, lifestyle and refined elegance, this exceptional residence sets a benchmark for sophisticated family living. Showcasing bespoke design elements, soaring double-height ceilings and an exceptional level of craftsmanship throughout, the home exudes quality, prestige and timeless appeal from the moment you arrive. A theatre room, upstairs retreat, versatile home office, (or fifth bedroom), resort-inspired swim spa and extensive vehicle accommodation further elevate the living experience, while a quiet park-front position adds another layer of appeal. Perfectly positioned to enjoy the very best of Williams Landing, the residence is moments from transport, shopping precincts, dining options and highly regarded schools.

The Point of Difference
- Bathed in natural light and enhanced by soaring double-height ceilings, the home offers an impressive selection of living spaces, including an expansive open-plan living and dining domain, complemented by an upstairs retreat and balcony overlooking the park frontage. Rich in warmth and sophistication, these beautifully curated spaces create an atmosphere of effortless luxury and refined entertaining.
- A fitted home office with built-in cabinetry provides an ideal work-from-home environment and may also be utilised as a fifth bedroom if desired.
- Designed to elevate the home entertainment experience, the theatre room is enclosed by striking feature barn doors and offers a private cinematic retreat.
- Beautifully appointed and designed to impress, the kitchen showcases quality stainless-steel appliances, generous preparation space, extensive storage, an Insinkerator, separate reverse osmosis water filtration system and a convenient servery window connecting effortlessly to the outdoor kitchen and entertaining area.
- Comprising four spacious bedrooms, the main bedroom features a walk-in robe and private ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms are serviced by a central bathroom and separate toilet. Additional rooms include a home office that can be covnerted to a fifth bedroom.
- A laundry chute and ample storage throughout complete the accommodation.
- Designed to create a resort-inspired retreat, the outdoor setting showcases a Vortex Aqualounge Swim Spa with an energy-efficient heat pump, outdoor kitchen, retractable awning with wind sensor, low-maintenance gardens, pet door access to a partially enclosed dog run and excellent privacy from neighbouring properties. Secure drive-through side access leads to a substantial gated area, ideal for accommodating a caravan, boat, trailer or additional vehicles.
- Additional highlights include an oversized double garage with internal access, double crossover driveway with additional off-street parking, plush wool carpets with premium underlay, plantation shutters to the front windows, remote-controlled double blinds to the feature voids, LED lighting throughout, ducted heating, split-system heating and cooling units to the upstairs bedrooms, alarm system, five security cameras, hardwired video doorbell with intercom, window locks, roller shutters to selected rooms, lockable parcel letterbox, driveway lighting, NBN connectivity, discreet council bin storage and extensive security features for added peace of mind.

The Point of Interest
Enjoying an enviable position opposite parkland, this address places an exceptional array of amenities and lifestyle attractions within easy reach. Williams Landing Train Station is just a short stroll away, providing effortless city-bound travel, while nearby freeway access ensures a seamless commute to both Melbourne CBD and Geelong. Residents will appreciate the convenience of Williams Landing Shopping Centre, local cafés, dining precincts, medical facilities and an extensive range of everyday services. Families are exceptionally well catered for with a selection of highly regarded schools nearby, including Westbourne Grammar School, Al-Taqwa College, St Martin de Porres Primary School, and Emmanuel college, further enhancing the appeal of this sought-after location.

A beautiful blend of relaxed coastal style and contemporary luxury, there is so much to love about this light-filled family home. Custom designed and built by the owners as their forever home, every detail has been thoughtfully considered - from the soaring ceilings and natural finishes to the effortless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

At the heart of the home is a bright, open-plan living area anchored by a cosy wood fire, while two separate outdoor entertaining spaces and a generous grassy backyard provide plenty of room to relax, play and entertain.

What YOU'LL LOVE:
- Statement pendant lighting
- A vaulted entrance ceiling creating an impressive sense of arrival
- Light-filled, open-plan living with raised ceilings
- Gas ducted heating and split-system cooling
- A cosy wood fire in the lounge
- Timber-lined feature recess and beautifully crafted raised bulkhead
- Contemporary kitchen with stone benchtops and a generous walk-in pantry
- 900mm stainless-steel gas cooktop, electric oven and dishwasher
- Luxurious main bedroom with walk-in robe, stylish ensuite and direct deck access
- Well-appointed family bathroom featuring a full-sized bath
- Two separate outdoor entertaining areas
- Spacious backyard with room for vegetable gardens, a swimming pool or whatever your family dreams of creating
- Native landscaping and a railway-sleeper pathway inspired by the local coastal walks

The generous backyard offers endless possibilities, whether that's vegetable gardens, a swimming pool or simply plenty of room for the family to enjoy. Custom designed and locally built by a family builder, this was created as our forever home, with care and craftsmanship evident in every detail.”

out.ogDescription:
Ideally positioned within easy walking distance of Torquay College, St Therese Primary School, the Children's Hub, Surf Shop precinct and a selection of local cafés and eateries, this beautifully presented two-storey residence delivers the space, flexibility and privacy families are looking for.
Designed with a practical layout and a wonderful sense of connection between the indoors and out, the home welcomes you on the ground floor with a dedicated second living area before opening into the spacious kitchen, living and dining zone. Large picture windows draw natural light into the home, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere while offering a lovely outlook across the established gardens.
The kitchen is well appointed with stone benchtops, pantry storage and stainless-steel appliances, while the adjoining living and dining area extends effortlessly outdoors to an expansive undercover deck. Complete with built-in storage, this generous entertaining space is ideal for relaxed family gatherings, weekend barbecues or simply enjoying the privacy of the beautifully landscaped surrounds. A well-equipped laundry and powder room complete the lower level.
Upstairs, a spacious landing provides an ideal study or reading zone, leading to four generous bedrooms. The main bedroom features a large walk-in robe and ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms include built-in robes and are serviced by a central family bathroom.
Outside, the fully fenced rear garden offers plenty of room for children and pets to play, with an expansive grassed area, established gardens, fire pit and covered entertaining area creating a private extension of the home. An outdoor shower adds further convenience, particularly after beach days.
Polished concrete floors, a gas log fire, split system heating and cooling, ceiling fans, substantial understairs storage are among the thoughtful features that add to the home throughout. A one and a half lock-up garage with internal access, as well as two off-street parks in the driveway completes the package.

29 Copeland Crescent, Point Cook

4 Bedrooms | Separate Study | 2 Bathrooms | Downstairs Powder Room | Double Garage | Approximately 507 m²

Nate Sabbarwal and YPA Point Cook proudly present 29 Copeland Crescent, a substantial double-storey family home offering generous living spaces, comfortable accommodation and an outstanding setting for entertaining in Point Cook's established Boardwalk Estate.

From the welcoming brick façade and arched entrance to the timber flooring, plantation shutters and expansive alfresco, this is a home with character, warmth and room to enjoy. Positioned on approximately 507 m², its practical layout brings together four upstairs bedrooms, a dedicated downstairs study, two distinct living areas and a separate dining space.

For families looking for somewhere to settle, spread out and make their own, the appeal extends beyond the bedroom count. There is space to work, space to welcome guests and space for everyone to enjoy their own routine.

Step inside and discover a floorplan that accommodates both everyday connection and time apart. The formal lounge sits towards the front of the home, creating an inviting setting for conversation, entertaining visitors or enjoying a quiet evening. Further through, the family area provides another comfortable gathering place, complemented by a generous dining zone for shared meals and celebrations.

This separation gives the home flexibility as family needs change. Children can enjoy their own activities while adults relax elsewhere, and larger gatherings can comfortably extend across several spaces.

The dedicated downstairs study is a valuable addition for those working from home, studying or managing a busy household. Measuring approximately 3.3 m x 2.7 m, it provides a defined place for a desk, shelving and daily tasks, allowing the bedrooms to remain dedicated to rest.

At the heart of the home, the kitchen combines generous preparation space with practical storage. An island bench provides a central workspace, while stainless steel appliances, extensive cabinetry and a walk-in pantry support everything from quick weekday meals to cooking for family and friends. Its relationship with the dining and family areas keeps the cook involved in the conversation.

Upstairs, the accommodation is thoughtfully separated from the main entertaining spaces. The main bedroom, measuring approximately 3.5 m x 4.9 m, offers room to unwind, with a walk-in wardrobe and an ensuite featuring a double vanity.

Three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for children, visiting family or a guest room, with built-in wardrobes shown in bedrooms two and three. A central bathroom with a bathtub and shower, together with a separate toilet, serves this level, while the downstairs powder room adds convenience for visitors.

The outdoor entertaining area is another standout. The large screened alfresco, shown on the floorplan as approximately 8.0 m x 4.2 m, creates a sheltered setting for dining, relaxing and spending time with friends. Imagine a long weekend lunch, a family birthday or simply taking your morning coffee outside.

Landscaped surrounds and an easy-care backyard complete the outdoor setting, offering an appealing balance between indoor accommodation and space to enjoy beyond the house.

The property's features include:

- Approximately 507 m² of land in the established Boardwalk Estate.
- A double-storey layout with four bedrooms on the upper level.
- Two separate living areas, allowing flexibility for different family activities.
- A front formal lounge measuring approximately 3.5 m x 5.9 m.
- A family living area measuring approximately 5.4 m x 3.5 m.
- A dedicated dining area measuring approximately 3.8 m x 4.6 m.
- A separate downstairs study or home office, approximately 3.3 m x 2.7 m.
- A generous main bedroom with a walk-in wardrobe and private ensuite.
- A double vanity in the main bedroom's ensuite.
- Built-in wardrobes to bedrooms two and three.
- A fourth bedroom offering flexibility for family accommodation or guests.
- A central upstairs bathroom with a bathtub and shower.
- A separate upstairs toilet.
- An additional downstairs powder room.
- A kitchen with an island bench and ample preparation space.
- Stainless steel kitchen appliances.
- A walk-in pantry and extensive kitchen cabinetry.
- Timber flooring bringing warmth to the main living spaces.
- Plantation shutters adding character and practical light control.
- Ducted heating.
- Two split-system units.
- A separate laundry with external access.
- Additional household storage.
- An expansive screened alfresco for outdoor dining and entertaining.
- Landscaped surrounds and an easy-care backyard.
- A remote-controlled double garage with internal access and access to the rear garden.

The Boardwalk Estate setting brings everyday amenities within easy reach, making this an appealing address for families balancing school, work, shopping and recreation.

Location highlights include:

- Convenient access to Point Cook Town Centre for supermarkets, everyday shopping, cafés and dining.
- Local schooling options nearby, including Carranballac P–9 College.
- Emmanuel College's Notre Dame Campus and Point Cook Senior Secondary College within the surrounding area.
- Access to local parks, playgrounds and walking paths for time outdoors.
- Childcare facilities and sporting amenities in the surrounding neighbourhood.
- Public transport options nearby.
- Convenient access to the Princes Freeway for travel towards Melbourne and Geelong.

Whether your next chapter calls for more bedrooms, a dedicated workspace or somewhere to bring everyone together, 29 Copeland Crescent offers a combination of accommodation, versatility and outdoor entertaining that deserves to be experienced in person.

Picture the furniture in place, family gathered around the dining table and weekends spent enjoying the alfresco. This is a home with room for everyday life and the occasions you will remember.

out.title: 80 Urban Drive, Williams Landing, Vic 3027 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
out.ogDescription:
Every now and then, a home comes to market that simply can't be compared to anything else.
Not because it's bigger.
Not because it's newer.
But because it was designed to be different.

Welcome to 80 Urban Drive, Williams Landing, an architecturally designed family residence where soaring spaces, luxury finishes and thoughtful design come together to create a home unlike anything currently available.

Positioned on a substantial 701m² (approx.) allotment within the prestigious Wyndham Waters Estate, this remarkable residence isn't just somewhere to live, it's somewhere you'll be proud to come home to every single day.

From the moment you arrive, it's obvious this isn't another project-built home. The striking façade, manicured gardens and timber-decked entrance immediately set the tone for what's waiting inside.

Then you open the front door...
And everything changes.

A Living Space That Leaves a Lasting Impression
The centrepiece of this remarkable home is the breathtaking open-plan living and dining area.
Towering 5.5-metre ceilings create an incredible sense of scale, while expansive windows flood the home with natural light from every direction.
Standing in this space, surrounded by glass and volume, you instantly appreciate why homes like this are so rarely offered for sale.
It's dramatic.
It's elegant.
And it's designed for families who love entertaining.
The gourmet kitchen forms the heart of the home, featuring stone benchtops, quality Blanco 900mm cooking appliances, Bosch dishwasher, tiled splashback and an extended walk-in pantry that offers exceptional storage and functionality.
Whether you're hosting dinner parties or enjoying quiet family meals, this is a space where everyone naturally comes together.

A Private Parents' Retreat Like No Other
While the downstairs level has been designed for family living, the entire upper level has been reserved exclusively for the homeowners.
Your own private sanctuary.
A generous retreat overlooks the stunning void below, creating the perfect second living space to unwind at the end of the day.
Beyond that awaits an oversized master suite featuring:
• A huge walk-in robe
• Luxurious dual vanity ensuite
• Spa bath
• Underfloor heating
• Separate toilet
It's less like a bedroom...
And more like checking into your own boutique hotel every night.

Designed for Family Life
Flexibility is one of this home's greatest strengths.
Offering the versatility of up to five bedrooms, the floorplan easily adapts to growing families, those working from home, or buyers wanting dedicated theatre, study or guest accommodation.
Outside, beautifully landscaped gardens surround a large alfresco entertaining area, creating the perfect environment for weekend barbeques, family celebrations or simply enjoying a quiet afternoon outdoors.
Every inch of the property has been carefully planned to create a home that's as practical as it is beautiful.

Prestigious Wyndham Waters Estate
Living in Wyndham Waters is about much more than owning a beautiful home.
Residents enjoy exclusive access to the Wyndham Waters Leisure Centre, featuring:
• Indoor swimming pool
• Fully equipped gym
• Tennis court
• BBQ facilities
• Function room

All accessed securely via residents' swipe card.
You'll also enjoy exceptional convenience with easy access to:
• Williams Landing Shopping Centre
• Williams Landing Train Station
• Williams Landing Town Centre
• Truganina South Primary School
• Westbourne Grammar School
• Childcare centres
• Wetlands, walking trails and parklands
• Princes Freeway connecting Melbourne and Geelong

It's one of the west's most desirable family communities-and it's easy to see why.

Premium Features
• Architecturally designed family residence
• Huge 701m² (approx.) allotment
• Stunning 5.5-metre void over the main living area
• Heated concrete flooring for year-round comfort
• Up to five bedrooms or flexible living configuration
• Upstairs parents' retreat with private living area
• Oversized master suite with luxurious ensuite, spa and walk-in robe
• Gourmet kitchen with Blanco 900mm appliances
• Extended walk-in pantry
• Stone benchtops throughout
• Large alfresco entertaining area
• Beautifully landscaped gardens
• Zoned slab heating with polished concrete flooring
• Four refrigerated heating and cooling split systems
• Solar panels with gas-boosted solar hot water
• Security cameras and alarm system
• Gigabit ethernet cabling throughout
• Hardwood timber staircase
• Double remote garage
• Side access
• Garden sheds and greenhouse

A Home That Can't Be Replicated
There are beautiful homes...
There are luxury homes...
And then there are homes like 80 Urban Drive.
A residence where architecture, scale and individuality come together to create something genuinely unforgettable.
Your family and friends will admire it.
Your children will grow up remembering it.
And unless someone is prepared to buy land and build from scratch, they're unlikely to ever own anything quite like it.
This isn't just another house.
It's a statement.
